data.value: Will Kestrel Analytics' CEO sign, or walk away from, the proposed five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office before the landlord's option expires next Friday?

Kestrel Analytics is considering a five-year lease on the Riverside Wharf office. The landlord has offered six months rent-free. The option to sign expires next Friday (2026-08-21). The CEO must decide by then.
